generation.explanation: Slice both solids into thin horizontal layers. Every layer of the cylinder is a full disc of area πr². A cone layer at height y has a radius that shrinks in a straight line, r(1 − y/h), so its area is πr²(1 − y/h)². Since the radius shrinks linearly, the area shrinks as a square. Adding up the layers gives V_cone/V_cyl = ∫₀¹(1−u)² du = 1/3. Use the "Slices" slider to see the stacked slabs get closer to exactly one third, and the "Cut height" slider to compare matching cross-sections of the two solids.
